promotion_gate_disposition.decision: The wheel needs NO promotion_gate content. Nothing vendored, nothing copied, no code added.
promotion_gate_disposition.why: Promotion gating is a qualification-time activity that runs in a maintainer/repo checkout (transcription N8-31/N8-32/44 -> review -> record), never at user runtime. The in-wheel resolve-time re-verification is unreachable in every shipped-state resolve: with the shipped-empty registry the auto path returns at the '[absent]' branch BEFORE any record validation, and the expert path never consults records.
promotion_gate_disposition.precise_installed_mechanics: CORRECTION to the vendoring draft's 'fail loud (FileNotFoundError on import)' wording: _assess_promotion inserts REPO_ROOT/'optimization_v8_native_default'/'tools' on sys.path (inserting a nonexistent dir does not raise) and 'import promotion_gate' sits OUTSIDE the defensive try/except (only promotion_gate.assess is inside), so in an installed tree the missing tool surfaces as ModuleNotFoundError propagating out of resolve_lw_backend -- loud, never a mis-qualification (B/C can never activate through it). Reachability requires a registry record that already passed shape/host/artifact-identity AND a repo-contained promotion_record file with matching sha -- i.e. a maintainer-crafted record in a non-repo tree; not reachable in shipped state.
promotion_gate_disposition.guard_property_for_future_work: If the wheel story is ever revisited (e.g. vendoring the pure tool), the invariant to keep is: a missing tool must never let a record qualify, and the shipped-empty registry must keep the whole path out of shipped-state resolves.
promotion_gate_disposition.docstring_record: The disposition is written into the package __init__.py docstring (see module_map), the designated lightweight vehicle; PROMOTION_POLICY.md and all promotion tooling untouched.
